newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 15.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Five European firms get bids for China's Three-Gorge dam project.
-- Fiscal 1998/99 state budget requests from ministries and agencies expected to rise three percent to 79.8 trillion yen.
-- Tokyo Metropolitan government to cut subsidies for private schools by 10 percent.
-- Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd customer-counselling office head stabbed to death near home.
-- Japan to set up special office to deal with chemical weapons abandoned in China.
-- Depleted uranium bullets left by United States in Okinawa removed to South Korea.
-- Reform panel wants number of government ministries and agencies reduced to 15 from current 22.
